nodes.label: EPal Application Requirements
nodes.rationale: User creates virtual AI characters and chats with them. Includes onboarding, character creation, media generation, memory, multiple chats, prompt randomization.

nodes.label: Scalability Design
nodes.rationale: Backend is stateless (JWT auth, no server sessions). WebSocket uses Redis pub/sub architecture-ready. vLLM scales vertically with tensor/pipeline parallelism and horizontally behind a load balancer. ComfyUI scales via multiple instances behind a queue worker. PostgreSQL can use read replicas.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Design
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose provides containerized cross-platform local development. PowerShell scripts (.ps1) for Windows and shell scripts (.sh) for Linux/macOS provide manual setup parity.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication Pattern
nodes.rationale: JWT-based authentication with separate access and refresh tokens enables stateless backend suitable for horizontal scaling behind a load balancer.

nodes.label: Memory Architecture
nodes.rationale: Sliding context window plus automatic summarization in the Chat.summary field provides long-term memory for characters.

nodes.label: Media Generation Concept
nodes.rationale: Characters detect requests for image/video/audio in natural language and generate media via ComfyUI. The app gracefully handles missing models.

nodes.label: ComfyScript Media Generation
nodes.rationale: Character creation uses ComfyScript to generate avatars via the generate_avatar service.

nodes.label: vLLM LLM Backend
nodes.rationale: LLMs use vLLM as an OpenAI-compatible API server for inference.

nodes.label: generate_media public API
nodes.rationale: If source_image_url is given, uses the charedit workflow (character sends a photo based on their avatar); otherwise falls back to the chargen workflow for generic image generation.

nodes.label: build_chat_context
nodes.rationale: Manages long-term memory via summarization when message count exceeds SUMMARY_THRESHOLD (40), keeping CONTEXT_WINDOW (20) recent messages verbatim. Includes previous summary as context for incremental summarization.

nodes.label: v2-inpainting-inference config
nodes.rationale: LatentInpaintDiffusion with UNet in_channels=9 and conditioning_key=hybrid for inpainting.

nodes.label: v1-inference_clip_skip_2 config
nodes.rationale: Uses FrozenCLIPEmbedder with layer hidden and layer_idx -2 (clip skip).

nodes.label: v2-inference config
nodes.rationale: use_ema set to false because this is an inference only config.

nodes.label: v2-inference_fp32 config
nodes.rationale: use_ema set to false because this is an inference only config; uses_fp16=False.

nodes.label: v1-inference config
nodes.rationale: cond_stage_trainable set to false, different from the one trained before.

nodes.label: v2-inference-v config
nodes.rationale: use_ema set to false because this is an inference only config; uses v-parameterization.

nodes.label: v1-inference_clip_skip_2_fp16 config
nodes.rationale: Uses FrozenCLIPEmbedder with layer hidden and layer_idx -2 (clip skip); use_fp16=True.

nodes.label: v2-inference-v_fp32 config
nodes.rationale: use_ema set to false because this is an inference only config; uses v-parameterization; uses_fp16=False.

nodes.label: v1-inpainting-inference config
nodes.rationale: UNet in_channels=9 (4 data + 4 downscaled image + 1 mask); conditioning_key=hybrid.

nodes.label: JWT Token Refresh Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Implements silent token refresh on 401 responses to maintain user sessions without explicit re-login.

nodes.label: Protected Route Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses React Router wrapper components to enforce authentication and onboarding completion before rendering protected pages.

nodes.label: User Onboarding Flow
nodes.rationale: Guides new users through a welcome screen before granting access to the main application features.
